summary: Elevate your investment game with our comprehensive training on commercial real estate strategies. Gain insights to build wealth and achieve financial freedom.
lede: Commercial real estate investment analysis evaluates property income, value, financing, and risk across sectors such as office, industrial, multi-family, and retail. For mid-level real estate professionals, this course covers practical underwriting and portfolio decision-making, including projecting net operating income and discounted cash flow, testing valuation assumptions, assessing debt coverage, and structuring multi-tier equity waterfalls. It also addresses due diligence, value-add plans, and portfolio risk.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for mid-level real estate professionals seeking to master institutional deal structuring and underwriting. This course is designed for: Commercial Real Estate Acquisition Managers structuring deal pipelines and evaluating target assets. Real Estate Asset Managers optimizing net operating income and long-term asset positioning. Commercial Mortgage Underwriters evaluating debt coverage ratios and sponsor execution risk. Real Estate Private Equity Associates building multi-tiered cash flow models and waterfall returns. Corporate Real Estate Directors assessing strategic property acquisitions and lease restructuring options. Portfolio Managers allocating capital across multi-family, industrial, retail, and office asset classes. Real Estate Investment Analysts evaluating financial viability and scenario sensitivity for target deals. Commercial Real Estate Brokers seeking advanced underwriting skills to advise institutional clients. Real Estate Development Managers structuring capital stacks and value-add repositioning budgets. Joint Venture Capital Partners auditing sponsor pro formas and negotiating promote hurdle structures.
modules: Commercial Real Estate Foundations and Sector Dynamics
Financial Modeling and Net Operating Income Analysis
Asset Valuation and Discounted Cash Flow Techniques
Capital Stack Structuring and Debt Financing
Equity Waterfall Structuring and Joint Ventures
Value-Add Investment Strategies and Asset Repositioning
Real Estate Due Diligence and ESG Integration
Investment Committee Strategy and Portfolio Management
prerequisites: Participants should possess a basic understanding of financial concepts, such as time value of money, as well as working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Prior experience in real estate, finance, or corporate business operations is recommended.
